description: Manage Pi-hole v6: DNS blocking, domains, clients, query analysis, DHCP, and multi-instance sync.
name: io.github.hexamatic/pihole-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Pi-hole web interface. For multiple Pi-holes use PIHOLE_1_URL, PIHOLE_2_URL, ... instead.
environmentVariables.name: PIHOLE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Pi-hole admin password, or an application password (recommended — bypasses TOTP 2FA)
environmentVariables.name: PIHOLE_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: IANA timezone for rendered timestamps, e.g. Australia/Adelaide. Defaults to UTC in the container.
environmentVariables.name: TZ

environmentVariables.description: Expose only inspection tools. Every tool that can change Pi-hole is hidden and rejected if called.
environmentVariables.name: PIHOLE_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Set to true only for a Pi-hole serving a self-signed HTTPS certificate. A trusted certificate is the better fix.
environmentVariables.name: PIHOLE_TLS_SKIP_VERIFY

environmentVariables.description: HTTP request timeout as a Go duration, e.g. 30s or 1m
environmentVariables.name: PIHOLE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: Retries after a transient Pi-hole API failure; 0 disables retrying
environmentVariables.name: PIHOLE_MAX_RETRIES

environmentVariables.description: Upper bound on a single exponential-backoff wait, as a Go duration
environmentVariables.name: PIHOLE_RETRY_MAX_DELAY

title: Pi-hole MCP Server
